name: Add
description: The square appears instantly.

name: Create
description: Draw the square outline progressively.

name: Uncreate
description: Erase the outline in reverse.

name: FadeIn
description: Increase opacity from transparent to visible.

name: FadeOut
description: Fade the square away.

name: MoveTo
description: Move the center to the target position.

name: Shift
description: Move by a relative displacement.

name: Rotate
description: Rotate half a turn around the object center.

name: Scale
description: Enlarge the object around its center.

name: FadeToColor
description: Blend blue into pink.

name: ApplyMatrix
description: Shear the object while the coordinate grid stays fixed.

name: Flash
description: Radiating strokes briefly emphasize the object center.

name: FocusOn
description: A shrinking circle directs attention to the object.

name: Circumscribe
description: Draw a temporary surrounding outline while preserving the object.

name: Indicate
description: Briefly enlarge and recolor, then restore the object.

name: ComplexHomotopy
description: Deform the outline with a complex map z and progress alpha.

name: Homotopy
description: Bend the outline with expressions in x, y and alpha.

name: ApplyPointwiseFunction
description: Interpolate toward a safe expression-defined mapping.

name: PhaseFlow
description: Integrate the rotational field with deterministic RK4.

name: Restore
description: Restore the object to its initial state.

name: Blink
description: Briefly blink, then restore the original opacity.

name: ApplyWave
description: Send a wave through the vector outline, then restore it.

name: Wiggle
description: Rock the object back and forth, then settle.

name: GrowFromCenter
description: Grow the object outward from its center.

name: GrowFromPoint
description: Expand the square from the fixed point (−3, −1).

name: GrowFromEdge
description: Grow outward while the left edge stays anchored.

name: SpinInFromNothing
description: Spin and grow the square around its center.

name: DrawBorderThenFill
description: Finish the outline before revealing the interior fill.

name: ShowPassingFlash
description: A short stroke travels around the outline, then disappears.

name: GrowArrow
description: Grow an arrow from its stationary tail.

name: AddTextLetterByLetter
description: Reveal or remove whole Unicode graphemes and words.

name: RemoveTextLetterByLetter
description: Reveal or remove whole Unicode graphemes and words.

name: AddTextWordByWord
description: Reveal or remove whole Unicode graphemes and words.

name: ShowIncreasingSubsets
description: Reveal group children in their declared order.

name: ShowSubmobjectsOneByOne
description: Reveal group children in their declared order.

name: MoveAlongPath
description: The point follows the curved guide.

name: Transform
description: Morph the square into a star while keeping the source object ID.

name: ReplacementTransform
description: Morph into a star and transfer visibility to the destination object.

name: Swap
description: Exchange positions or crossfade two drawable objects.

name: FadeTransform
description: Exchange positions or crossfade two drawable objects.

name: TransformFromCopy
description: Morph a temporary copy into the target while leaving the source unchanged.

name: CyclicReplace
description: Each object moves to the next object’s starting center; the last moves to the first.

name: LaggedStartMap
description: Apply one animation template to a list of targets.

name: AnimateParameter
description: Animate a from 0.5 to 2: the graph and number update together.

name: EventGroup
description: Three circles move at the same time.

name: Succession
description: Each circle starts after the previous one finishes.

name: LaggedStart
description: The circles start at staggered times with overlap.

name: CameraZoom
description: Zoom the camera toward the origin; the object coordinates stay unchanged.

name: CameraWindow
description: Pan and zoom to fit x ∈ [1,5], y ∈ [−2,2].

name: CameraMove
description: Move the 3D viewpoint while preserving interactive orbit controls.

name: CameraOrbit
description: Move the 3D viewpoint while preserving interactive orbit controls.

name: ApplySpaceMatrix
description: Shear the whole coordinate plane, including its grid and objects.

name: ApplyComplexFunction
description: Warp the plane with the complex map z → z + 0.12z².

name: SwitchSpace
description: Crossfade from a circle scene to a star scene. Both are ordinary 2D spaces.

name: Easing
description: Compare the four easing curves over the same distance and duration.
